title: Same SIP. Two Plans. ₹20L Difference — SEBI Just Changed the Rules #Shorts
description:
SEBI's November 1, 2026 circular changed everything. Direct mutual fund plans are now the default on all AMC platforms — no more getting quietly pushed into the Regular plan that charges 1.5% instead of 0.5%.

📊 Key Numbers:
• Regular plan expense ratio: 1–1.5% (includes distributor commission)
• Direct plan expense ratio: 0.3–0.5% (zero middleman)
• 20-year SIP gap: ₹20+ lakh extra in your pocket on a ₹10K/month SIP
• 70% of SIP investors were on Regular plans before this rule
• Effective date: November 1, 2026 (SEBI circular Oct 30, 2026)

What to do now:
1. Visit MFCentral.in
2. Find your Regular plan SIPs
3. Switch to Direct — takes 5 minutes, completely free
